auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.panelPoint1: Practise Listening and Reading in realistic timed conditions.
auth.panelPoint2: Get detailed feedback on your writing, criterion by criterion.
auth.panelPoint3: Pick up where you left off, on any device.
auth.loginBody: Sign in to continue your IELTS preparation.
auth.registerBody: Start preparing with a free IELTiva account.
auth.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of service and privacy policy
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a verification link to {email}. It expires in 24 hours.
auth.emailNotDeliveredBody: We couldn't send your verification email just now. You can sign in, then request a new link.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your email and we'll send a reset link if it matches an account.
auth.forgotDoneBody: If that email matches an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 60 minutes.
auth.resendDoneBody: If that account needs verifying, a new link is on its way.
auth.resetBody: After this, you'll be signed out everywhere and can sign in with your new password.
auth.resetDoneBody: You've been signed out on all devices. Sign in with your new password.
auth.linkInvalidBody: It may be incomplete or out of date. You can request a new one.
auth.verifyBody: Enter your email and we'll send a new verification link.
auth.verifiedBody: Thanks for confirming your address. You're ready to continue.

googleError.generic: Google sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
googleError.invalid_state: That sign-in attempt has expired. Please try again.
googleError.google_denied: Sign-in was cancelled at Google. You can try again whenever you like.
googleError.google_unavailable: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Please use your email and password.
googleError.session_changed: Your session changed during linking. Sign in and try again.
googleError.google_validation_failed: We couldn't confirm your Google account. Please try again.
googleError.email_not_verified: Your Google email isn't verified. Verify it with Google, then try again.
googleError.account_exists: This email already has an IELTiva account. Sign in with your password, verify your email, then link Google from your account.
googleError.already_linked: This Google account is already linked to another IELTiva account.
googleError.verify_email_first: Verify your IELTiva email before linking Google.
googleError.account_unavailable: This account isn't available. Please contact support.

auth.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this page
auth.forbiddenBody: Your account doesn't include this area. If you think that's wrong, please contact support.
auth.studentBody: Your learning tools will appear here as they become available.
auth.adminBody: Administration tools will appear here as they become available.
auth.unverifiedBody: Check your inbox for the verification link.
auth.name: Name
